en: Occupying the honored position, it serves as the master of contention, using its centered correctness to judge the crooked and the straight
Receiving the favor of the one above, it serves as the master of the army
Being the lord of Alliance with a correspondent in the Second—this is manifest alliance
This qualifies one to serve as an agent of the ruler, but it is not the Way of being a ruler

zh: 言乎一卦之所以為主也

en: The second line is the master of Fellowship with People

Being both impartial and trustworthy, what difficulty arises, what defenses are needed? When teaching is carried out without speaking, how could there not be awe? As the ruler of Great Possession, if one did not follow this Way, could auspiciousness be attained?
It treads a position that is not its own and supports the master of active enthusiasm
The Fourth, through firm movement, is the master of Enthusiasm and monopolizes authority and control

Dwelling in the noble position, serving as the master of Contemplation, broadly proclaiming the great transforming influence, its radiance reaching the four quarters—this is the ultimate of Contemplation
Being the master of transformation above, when one intends to observe oneself, one in fact observes the people
Although it is a yang line in substance and acts as the master of the yin lines, it treads without obtaining the center and occupies an improper position
Occupying the honored position, it is the master of adornment—the most flourishing in adornment
Situated in the time of Stripping, it occupies the honored position and is the master of Stripping
Dwelling in the honored position, this is the ruler of Without Falseness
The firm comes from without and becomes the ruler within
What could this be if not great success through benefit and correctness? When the firm comes from without and becomes the ruler within, then the way of the soft and deviant is eliminated
The Fifth occupies the honored position and is the master of accumulation
Being yang and dwelling above while treading upon four yin lines—yin cannot independently serve as master and must defer to yang
" Being the master of the many yin lines, it must not be treated with disrespect, hence danger brings good fortune
Being the master of nourishment, nothing goes against it, hence it is beneficial to cross the great river
Being the lord of Kan, yet having no corresponding helper to assist itself, it has not yet been able to fill the pit
Being the lord of Kan, only when it is completely leveled is there no blame
Occupying the honored position and serving as the ruler of Duration, yet unable to exercise authoritative judgment on what is right
The ruler of Ming Yi resides in the Top Six
Having punished the ruler, one is about to set the people right

'

This means removing the benighted ruler
' As the master of the lower trigram, this is what the inner [trigram] relies upon
The Supreme Deity is the lord of the generation of living things, the source of flourishing increase, the one who emerges through Zhen and brings all to order through Xun
Attaining the proper position and treading in the place of honor, this is the master of Increase
having encountered an opening it rushes through, scattered and without a master, giving itself free rein
but if used to serve as the master of things, it leads to ruin
Situated in the midst of four yin lines and dwelling in a time of fear and trembling, one serves as the master of the many yin lines and should embolden oneself to bring peace to the multitude
As the master of Dispersion, only the king may dwell in this position, and only then is there no blame
Occupying the proper position and dwelling in the center, as the master of regulation one does not lose the mean

Dwelling in a time of mutual exchange through inner sincerity, occupying the honored position as lord of all things — how could sincerity be abandoned? Therefore, having sincerity that binds together, only then is there no blame

Dwelling in the honored position with yielding, situated at the fullness of cultural brilliance, serving as the ruler of Not Yet Across—therefore one must be correct and only then is there good fortune
